description: TI TXS0108E — 8-bit bidirectional level shifter, auto-direction sensing, 1.4-3.6V ↔ 1.65-5.5V, 60 Mbps max data rate. No direction pin needed. TSSOP-20 package. The standard solution for 3.3V ↔ 5V logic translation.
name: txs0108e
watch_out_for: Auto-direction sensing works for push-pull and open-drain. ONE-SHOT edge acceleration — may cause increased EMI on long traces. 10kΩ internal pull-ups on I/O lines. Not suitable for I2C (use PCA9306 or dedicated I2C level shifter). VCCA ≤ VCCB always. OE pin (active low) can disable all outputs.
